An update is available for emacs.
This update affects Rocky Linux 10.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
GNU Emacs is a powerful, customizable, self-documenting text editor. It provides special code editing features, a scripting language (elisp), and the capability to read e-mail and news.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* emacs-29.4-9.el10 missing fix for CVE-2024-53920 (arbitrary code execution via Lisp macro expansion) (JIRA:Rocky Linux-152088)

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
